# Report a security vulnerability

Use
[Glimmer's private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/Se7enbrc/glimmer/security/advisories/new)
for Mac, iPhone/iPad and shared-engine vulnerabilities. Include the affected
version or commit, impact and reproduction steps. Do not post pairing keys,
PINs, certificates or private logs in public issues.

The [shared security policy](../docs/SECURITY.md#reporting) describes response
and disclosure targets. Read [protocol security](../docs/PROTOCOL_SECURITY.md)
for pairing, encryption and local trust boundaries, and
[privacy](../docs/PRIVACY.md) before sharing diagnostic material.
